position: International Trade Administration: Enforcement and Compliance
proposal: The Mandate recommends that ITA's Enforcement and Compliance unit work with Customs and other agencies to counter circumvention and unpaid duties. It asks for higher cash deposits or asset registration for importers of record, revival of a China-specific non-market economy unit, and a new method for determining normal values in Chinese antidumping cases.

title: Tighten AD/CVD enforcement against China and duty evasion
uncertainties: Circumvention rulings are an ongoing statutory activity, so they show continued enforcement rather than a new policy; the progress figure is a judgment. A web search surfaced the annual China surrogate country list memo for 2025, which was not opened and is a routine product. No step to revive a China non-market economy unit was found.
